The Repo as a scientific publication

For whom?

Students, corpus researchers and model groups should independently get to a comprehensible investigation from a download.

What collection?

data/tei contains the relevant book files. Solutions are associated with puzzle identifiers. Automatic annotations are separated and call procedures and test status.

How to get in?

README explains inventory, license, structure and first call. Small examples, subpackages and complete data can be used locally without a university account.

How to release?

Exams, inventory comparison and targeted technical reading precedes the release. Tag, release notes and archive package denote the publication.

How to improve?

Errors are reported as issues, corrections are checked and described in new releases. Older research findings remain referenceable; their defects will not become mandatory for future versions.

OUR RECOMMENDATION FOR BOOKS

A name that helps people and scripts

rk_1786_b0001.xml

rk
corpus abbreviations
1786
Documented year of publication; without known year indication: undatiert
b0001
Stable book identification, even if title or dating are corrected
  1. Uniform and meaningful: same order, fixed number of posts and the ending .xml. Title and detailed source description are in the metadata.
  2. Platform compatible: short ASCII names, lowercase letters and relative paths. No spaces, umlauts, colons or reserved device names; no names that differ only in case of uppercase. README.md, LICENSE, CITATION.cff and CHANGELOG.md retain their standard spelling.
  3. For automations: the fixed pattern allows filters by year or book identification. The entrance exam compares this information with the relevant metadata.
  4. Amendments are regulated: Do not change names casually. If the date is corrected, specifically rename it to Git, get the stable book ID and explain the change in the changelog.

Filter example: rk_1786_*.xml selects the correspondingly named book files of the year 1786. Unknown datings are about rk_undatiert_b0004.xml.
